title: foundation-platform.parcel_public_auction_by_pnu major 1 revision 3
description: A parcel's open onbid public auction rounds, served by PNU on the parcel edge (lane parcel-public-auction). A field that is not required may be absent or null. Revision 3 (root ADR-0340 §7) adds the rest of each round's list row (the provider's names of its codes, the bid conditions, the organisations) and, once per document, the item blocks (detail, bid information, earlier rounds' results, maps) and the announcement-round blocks (text, attachments, organisation, opening) the rounds name.

photos.description: The round's onbid media, content-addressed: the web builds each public URL from sha256 and media_format (root ADR-0296 §5)
